sources.title: Saved vCenter and ESXi connections. Their passwords stay in the cluster and are never shown again.
sources.emptyHint: Add a vCenter or ESXi connection to browse its inventory and plan a migration.

source.description: The cluster stores the connection and checks the server's certificate fingerprint before it sends the password.
source.hostHint: vCenter or ESXi host name or IP address
source.passwordKeep: Leave empty to keep the saved password.
source.vddkHint: Needed for vSAN and vVols. The operator installs nbdkit and VDDK on the nodes.
source.libdirHint: Empty uses the node setting [vmware] vddk_libdir.
source.untrusted: {{host}} presented a certificate this cluster has not seen. Compare the fingerprint with the one in vCenter before you trust it.
source.deleteDescription: Migrations that use this source must be deleted first. Nothing changes on the VMware side.

errors.name: Use lowercase letters, digits and hyphens (up to 63).
errors.nameTaken: A source with this name already exists.

migrations.title: Move many VMware VMs with one set of rules. Warm migrations copy running VMs and keep syncing changed blocks until cutover.
migrations.emptyHint: Add a VMware source, then pick VMs from its inventory.

mode.warmHint: The source keeps running. Changed blocks are copied again and again; downtime is only the cutover.
mode.coldHint: Powered-off VMs are copied once. Running VMs are refused.

migration.cancelDescription: Our snapshots and target volumes are removed. Source VMs stay as they are; VMs already cut over stay.
migration.deleteDescription: The plan and its items are deleted. Created VMs, volumes and the source VMs stay.

cutover.description: Each source VM is shut down, the last changes are copied and the new VM is created. If a step fails, the source is powered on again.
cutover.total: About {{time}} of downtime in total (one after another at most).

shutdown.guest: The guest is shut down through VMware Tools (waits up to {{timeout}} s).
shutdown.power-off: The source is powered off without a guest shutdown.

cutover.protect: Source NICs stay disconnected at power-on so the same MAC and IP never come up twice.
cutover.rollback: The source VM is never deleted.

revert.title: Revert {{name}}?
revert.description: {{name}} is stopped and the source VM {{source}} is powered on again.
revert.dataLost: Data written on the new VM since the cutover is not copied back.
revert.keeps: The new VM and its volumes stay, powered off.

finalize.title: Finalize {{name}}?
finalize.description: Our snapshots and change tracking are removed from the source. After this the VM cannot be reverted.

cancelItems.description: Our snapshot and the target volumes are removed. The source VM stays as it is.

wizard.title: New VMware migration
wizard.hint: Pick a source, choose VMs, map networks and datastores once, check every VM, then start.
wizard.draftLocked: Draft {{name}} is already saved; its name, source and mode stay.
wizard.blockedLeftOut_one: {{count}} blocked VM is left out of the migration when it starts.
wizard.blockedLeftOut_other: {{count}} blocked VMs are left out of the migration when it starts.

errors.name: Use lowercase letters, digits and hyphens (up to 63).
errors.nameTaken: A migration with this name already exists.
errors.tooMany: A migration holds up to 200 VMs. Split it into waves.
errors.pool: Choose a pool or a default pool.
errors.range: Enter a whole number in range.

picker.searchHint: Name, path, OS, host or IP

mapping.networksHint: Only networks the chosen VMs use. Leave one unmapped and the check will tell you.
mapping.flat: Put all VMs in one folder
mapping.keepMacsHint: DHCP reservations and licenses bound to a MAC keep working.
mapping.reserveIpsHint: On SDN networks, IPs reported by VMware Tools are reserved for the new VM.
mapping.startAfter: Start the new VM after cutover

policy.maxParallelHint: Syncs and cutovers running together in this migration (1–64).
policy.stopAfterHint: Our snapshot does not stay on the source for long. 0 never stops.
policy.maxFinalDeltaHint: Cutover stops before the source is touched if the last delta is larger. Empty means no limit.
policy.cutoverAtHint: Empty means you cut over by hand.
policy.protectSourceHint: Source NICs are set to stay disconnected at power-on and a note is added.

errors.vmware_auth: The VMware server refused the user name or password.
errors.vmware_unreachable: The VMware server cannot be reached: {{message}}
errors.untrusted_certificate: Check the server certificate fingerprint and trust it to continue.
errors.fingerprint_mismatch: The server certificate changed since it was trusted. Check the new fingerprint.
errors.source_in_use: Migrations still use this source. Delete them first.
errors.source_not_found: The VMware source no longer exists.
errors.vmware_vm_not_found: A chosen VM is no longer in the inventory. Read the inventory again.
errors.vm_in_migration: A chosen VM is already in another migration: {{message}}
errors.migration_running: Pause the migration before changing it.
errors.migration_state: The migration cannot do that now: {{message}}
errors.migration_active: Cancel the migration first; some VMs are still migrating.
errors.migration_busy: Another change is running. Try again.
errors.vm_started: A started VM cannot be removed; cancel it instead.
errors.vmware_vm_state: This VM cannot do that now: {{message}}
errors.not_ready: Only ready or syncing VMs can be cut over.
errors.vmware_permission: The VMware user may not do this: {{message}}
errors.vmware_restricted: This ESXi host is read only (free license). Use a cold migration.
